text:
incident-bot: Paging SEV1 — runtime-prod: container crashloop on node gpu-14 (SIGSEGV). Auto-created incident channel and attached logs.

sre_jen: I’m on it. seeing repeated segfaults in runtime-container, restart loop every ~30s.

eng_omar: can you paste the last container logs? any core dumps on /var/crash?

sre_jen: logs attached to the incident ticket but tail here:
```
[2026-03-17T02:12:03Z] runtime[pid=4321]: WARNING: CUDA driver 12.1 available
[2026-03-17T02:12:04Z] runtime[pid=4321]: INFO: loading model acme-llm v2.1
[2026-03-17T02:12:05Z] runtime[pid=4321]: ERROR: signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at 0x7f9cdeaf1b20
[2026-03-17T02:12:05Z] runtime[pid=4321]: backtrace: 0x7f9cdeaf1b20 0x7f9cdeaf0fa0 0x55a2c3d4
```

ml_oncall_maria: we’re seeing increased 500s from AcmeCorp during this window (their traffic hits hosted-dedicated cluster). Impact estimate: ~4.8% error rate over last 10m.

customer_ops: AcmeCorp support pinged, they're seeing inference failures and slow retries. They have a campaign today so elevated priority.

eng_omar: likely SIGSEGV inside TensorRT executor wrapper. Ask: any library version mismatch? check /usr/local/lib and container image tags. Also request a symbolized backtrace.

platform_ryan: node gpu-14 was recently kernel-updated yesterday. I’ll check dmesg and kube events.

sre_jen: started capturing core dump with coredumpctl, copying to /tmp/cores/runtime-4321.core.

eng_omar: good. running quick addr2line locally to get function names. If we don’t have matching symbols in the container image, we’ll need to pull the image built with debug symbols or use the artifact server.

eng_omar: quick findings from symbolization (local approximate):
```
# gdb --batch --ex "thread apply all bt full" --core runtime-4321.core /opt/redwood/bin/runtime
#0  0x00007f9cdeaf1b20 in trt::Executor::execute() at trt_executor.cpp:412
#1  0x00007f9cdeaf0fa0 in redwood::runtime::execute_model() at runtime_model.cpp:128
#2  0x000055a2c3d4abcd in main_loop at main.cpp:78
```

eng_omar: looks like a null deref in the TRT execution path when using fused-kernel path. This node hosts a mix of quantized models; might be a bad kernel selection for certain sequence length.

ml_oncall_maria: can we flip the model to non-fused variant for AcmeCorp as immediate mitigation? should reduce perf but avoid crash.

platform_ryan: plan proposal: 1) cordon gpu-14 to stop new pods, 2) drain existing runtime pods to other nodes, 3) apply env override REDWOOD_TRT_FUSE=0 in rollout for affected deployment, 4) restart with increased restartBackoff to avoid tight crashloops.

sre_jen: I’ll cordon and drain now. tagging @eng_omar to apply safe rollout for model routing.

platform_ryan: cordoned node gpu-14. draining pods -> evicted 4 runtime pods. they are landing on gpu-22 and gpu-23.

eng_omar: I pushed a temporary patch to the runtime config service to set REDWOOD_TRT_FUSE=false for cluster:d:south-1 (scope: acme-tenant). rolling config to 50% first.

sre_jen: after drain, new pods on gpu-22 are stable. crash count down to 0 for those instances.

customer_ops: AcmeCorp reports degraded performance but errors stopped for now. they appreciate the rapid mitigation.

ml_oncall_maria: metrics: error rate dropped from 4.8% -> 0.3% in 8 minutes after mitigation. latency increased ~30-40ms p95 (expected).

eng_omar: root cause hypothesis: a TensorRT fused-kernel path triggered a bad pointer when sequence length > 2048 on that particular build. suspect mismatch between TRT runtime and our fused-kernel binary compiled against older CUDA headers.

platform_ryan: dmesg on gpu-14 shows no hardware faults. kernel and driver versions: kernel 5.19.0-rt, nvidia-driver 535. Node image matches others but the runtime container image on gpu-14 was an older cached image (image pull policy was IfNotPresent).

eng_omar: ah — image cache stale. That explains symbol mismatch. We should enforce imagePullPolicy: Always for runtime DaemonSet and add an automated check for node-level image age.

sre_jen: handing off to next oncall: @eng_omar will track hotfix + postmortem, @platform_ryan will ensure node image sweep and imagePullPolicy update, @ml_oncall_maria to validate model tests against fused and non-fused kernels.

eng_omar: immediate next steps: build debug-symbol image for fused-kernel path, reproduce in staging with seq len >2048, run ASAN if possible, and prepare a runtime patch. ETA for hotfix candidate: 4 hours.

platform_ryan: I’ll add a temporary admission controller rule to fail IfNotPresent on new pods and schedule a cluster sweep to clear stale images.

sre_jen: leaving incident channel, oncall handoff to eng_omar. I’ll follow up in the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:

eng_omar: taking over oncall. keeping channel open until hotfix lands and we confirm stability.

customer_ops: customer notified of mitigation and ongoing work. will send a follow-up once hotfix deployed.

eng_omar: update 45m: reproduced crash in staging with cached-runtime image. built debug image and collected full symbolized backtrace. root cause confirmed — bad pointer in fused kernel for case of padded attention lengths. patching allocator bounds check now.

eng_omar: patch pushed to canary, enabling fused kernels only for canary group with additional checks. monitoring.

ml_oncall_maria: canary metrics look good; no crashes and performance within acceptable range. will expand rollout to 25% then 100% if stable.

eng_omar: rollout to 25% -> 100% complete. confirmed no regressions in production for 30m.

sre_jen: verifying error rates and customer signals. AcmeCorp confirms full recovery. closing incident channel and filing postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident SEV1 closed. Summary: Crashloop due to stale container image + fused-Trt kernel pointer bug. Mitigation: cordon/drain, disable fused path, rollout hotfix with bounds check, enforce imagePullPolicy.

eng_omar: postmortem owners: eng-runtime (lead), platform (image policy), ml-eng (task tests). I’ll create the postmortem doc and link here.

customer_ops: thanks everyone — good job on the fast mitigation. :clap:
